name: Premier Village Phu Quoc Resort
short_description: A 215-villa all-villa resort on Ong Doi Cape, southern Phu Quoc, with every villa featuring a private pool and ocean views.
ai_summary: Premier Village Phu Quoc Resort is a 215-villa all-villa property on Ong Doi Cape at the southern tip of Phu Quoc, Accor-managed and positioned as one of the island's most exclusive beach retreats. Every villa has its own private swimming pool, a large living and dining room, a spacious kitchenette, and ocean views, with configurations ranging up to multi-bedroom villas for families or groups. Guest reviews are consistently glowing, frequently calling it the best resort in Phu Quoc, with sea views, well-maintained grounds, and exceptionally friendly, professional staff repeatedly highlighted, though a handful of reviews flag inconsistent concierge service for arranging transportation.

faqs.question: Does every villa at Premier Village Phu Quoc Resort have a private pool?
faqs.answer: Yes -- all 215 villas include their own private swimming pool along with a large living and dining room, a spacious kitchenette, and ocean views, making it an all-villa resort rather than a mix of standard rooms and villas.

faqs.question: Is Premier Village Phu Quoc Resort good for families?
faqs.answer: Yes -- multi-bedroom villa configurations suit families or groups traveling together, and the resort is consistently rated among the best in Phu Quoc by guests, though its remote Ong Doi Cape location means a longer transfer from the airport.
